classification_rules.LIVE_PRODUCTION_EVIDENCE: Real customer transactions from live payment gateway (N/A in offline dev)
classification_rules.HISTORICAL_REFERENCE: Locked IEEE-CIS development dataset (N=6,800) and held-out test dataset (N=1,200)
classification_rules.SYNTHETIC_TEST: Controlled fault-injection fixtures (amount surges, velocity bursts, tampered hashes)
classification_rules.LOCAL_RELIABILITY_TEST: Simulated continuous local API traffic to profile latency, concurrency, and stability
